jobs.title: Engineer Grid Expansion
jobs.description:
Netherlands Infrastructure & Energy 2 - 5 years Hengelo On-site

Do you, as an engineer, want to make a direct contribution to the energy transition? In this role, you will work on strengthening and expanding the electricity grid, ensuring that the Netherlands is ready for the future.

About The Member Company

We are a global high-tech consultancy company with a team of entrepreneurial engineers, scientists, and digital experts from around the world. Together we form a fast-growing and proud community. We offer consultancy services to high-profile clients globally in diverse service areas, such as:

* Technology & Engineering
* Energy & Renewables
* Life sciences & Pharma
* Digital & IT

**About this vacancy**
----------------------

As an Engineer Net Expansion, you are responsible for designing and preparing projects within the underground infrastructure. You work on expanding and improving the electricity grid, constantly collaborating with internal and external stakeholders. Responsibilities: - Designing cable and pipeline routes for electricity grid expansions - Creating technical designs and execution plans (e.g., in AutoCAD and GIS systems) - Coordinating with clients, grid operators, municipalities, and permit issuers - Contributing ideas for the most efficient and feasible execution methods - Monitoring the progress, quality, and costs of your projects - Identifying risks and obstacles and proactively addressing them - Contributing to innovative solutions within the energy transition - You are involved from start to finish: from design to implementation and delivery.

**What we expect from you**
---------------------------

* You are technically skilled, work meticulously, and feel responsible for your projects. At the same time, you are adept at coordinating with various stakeholders.
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Technology, Civil Engineering, or a similar field
* At least 3 years of experience in underground infrastructure engineering (cables & pipelines)
* Experience with design tools such as AutoCAD and/or GIS (ArcGIS)
* Knowledge of and interest in grid expansions and energy-related issues
* Strong communication skills in Dutch
* Proactive, result-oriented, and responsible
* Possession of a driver's license (Category B)

**What you can expect from us**
-------------------------------

At TMC, we combine challenging technical projects with a strong focus on your growth and development. Our unique Employeneurship formula ensures that you have control over your career while being supported by a solid team and excellent conditions:

* An indefinite employment contract, with a salary ranging from €3700 to €4600+ gross per month, depending on experience.
* An attractive individual profit-sharing plan.
* A training budget of €2200 per year, allowing you to continue developing within your field of expertise.
* Collaborating with experienced professionals within our Infra cell.
* Access to the TMC Entrepreneurial Lab to develop your innovative ideas.

#LI-SN1

**The 5 basic principles of employeneurship**
---------------------------------------------

As pioneers in employeneurship, we have redefined the traditional work model. We offer our employeneurs the opportunity to combine the security of a permanent contract with their passion for entrepreneurship.

A long-term working relationship

Enjoy the security of a long-term contract and a stable source of income while getting the opportunity to work at diverse projects.

Individual profit sharing

Full transparency. That’s it. For each of your projects, you know your hourly rate, your costs, and your individual performance-based profit sharing, all in order to stimulate your inner entrepreneur.

Business cells

Our employeneurs are grouped in business cells based on their technical expertise. They are small, focused and function as high-grade knowledge networks. And as buzzing communities of close colleagues.

YOUniversity

Every employeneur drives their own career. Together, we make a plan for personal and professional growth. Receive personal coaching and an extensive training budget to keep developing yourself and deliver outperformance at our clients.

The Entrepreneurial Lab

Work on your technical ambitions within our Entrepreneurial Lab (TEL). Here, you are given the space to explore ideas, experiment, and develop them into tangible solutions. In multidisciplinary teams, you collaborate with colleagues from different fields, bringing in new perspectives and accelerating innovation. The lab not only provides access to knowledge and resources, but also encourages ownership. This allows you to develop not only your technical expertise, but also your entrepreneurial skills, enabling you to actively contribute to solutions that truly make a difference.

jobs.title: Process Safety Engineer
jobs.description:
Why Work at Clarke

Our work is guided by our purpose: creating an energy-resilient world for a better future. This purpose embodies the legacy we bring, with more than 100 years as the global leader in energy resilience, delivering solutions critical to sustain and improve life.

Our teams have the opportunity to provide a critical resource – energy – that ensures safety, security, and independence for people around the world. Our team members are focused on pushing boundaries, continuing to innovate in an ever-changing landscape, and keeping up with the pace required to create solutions for today’s world demands.

Our product range includes engines, generators, power conversion, UPS systems, EV components and electrification solutions, microgrid controls and management, and clean energy solutions that serve a broad spectrum of OEM, residential, industrial, and commercial customers. At Rehlko, you have the freedom to identify, create, and deliver solutions – large and small – that help people and communities thrive in the moments that matter.

At Rehlko, our team members are the essential energy that powers our organization’s success. We are committed to fostering a safe and sustainable work environment where safety is everyone’s responsibility. We empower every team member to actively participate in our Zero Is Possible safety culture by encouraging open communication, proactively reporting hazards, following protocols, and suggesting improvements. Join us in creating an energy resilient world for a better future!

**What We Offer**

At Rehlko, our Total Rewards programs are designed to accelerate growth, energize performance, and support a culture of inclusion at every stage of life and work. We offer total rewards that are easily understood, recognize results, enable career mobility, and reflect our commitment to valuing diverse needs in a fast-moving world. We provide:

* Competitive compensation and benefits
* Work-life flexibility
* Recognition and rewards
* Development and career opportunities
* A safe and inclusive workplace

**Why You Will Love this Job**

P2 level for the role has been defined.

**Process Safety Engineer**

**Job Purpose**

To provide specialist process safety engineering support across a wide range of sustainable energy projects, including gas-powered generation, CHP, biogas, hydrogen, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and other low-carbon energy technologies. You will play a key role in identifying, assessing and mitigating process safety risks, ensuring compliance with relevant legislation, industry standards and best practice throughout all stages of project delivery.

Working closely with Electrical, Mechanical and Project Engineering teams, you will help ensure that Clarke Energy projects are designed, installed and operated safely, supporting our commitment to operational excellence and the transition to net zero energy.

**Majority of time spent:** Leading and supporting process safety activities across engineering projects, including hazard identification, risk assessments, safety studies and the development of safety documentation.

**We are looking for an experienced and proactive Process Safety Engineer to join our team.**

This is an exciting opportunity to influence the safe design and delivery of innovative energy projects across the UK and internationally. You will work alongside multidisciplinary engineering teams to embed process safety principles throughout the project lifecycle and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the business.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Process Safety Management:** Develop, implement and promote process safety management practices across engineering and operational activities.
* **Hazard Identification & Risk Assessment:** Lead and facilitate HAZOP studies, LOPA reviews, FMEA assessments, SIL assessments and other risk-based safety reviews.
* **Engineering Design Support:** Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure process safety requirements are incorporated into equipment, systems and plant designs.
* **Regulatory Compliance:** Ensure compliance with relevant legislation, industry standards and best practice, including COMAH, ATEX, ISO standards and other applicable regulations.
* **Safety Studies & Documentation:** Produce and review process safety documentation, including risk assessments, safety cases, hazardous area classifications and operating procedures.
* **Incident Investigation:** Support investigations into process safety incidents and near misses, identifying root causes and implementing corrective and preventative actions.
* **Operational Safety:** Assist with the development and maintenance of safe systems of work, operational procedures and emergency response plans.
* **Training & Awareness:** Deliver process safety training and promote awareness across engineering, operations and project teams.
* **Project Support:** Provide process safety engineering support throughout project development, installation, commissioning and operational phases.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Analyse process safety performance data and recommend initiatives to improve safety culture and reduce operational risk.
* **Client & Stakeholder Engagement:** Liaise with clients, suppliers and regulatory bodies as required, providing specialist process safety expertise.

**Technical / Professional Knowledge and Skills**

* Strong knowledge of process safety principles and risk management methodologies, including HAZOP, LOPA, SIL, FMEA and ATEX.
* Understanding of industrial process systems, control systems and safety instrumented systems.
* Knowledge of UK and international process safety legislation and standards, including COMAH and relevant ISO standards.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess complex technical risks.
* Experience preparing technical reports, safety documentation and engineering recommendations.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to communicate complex technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Project management and stakeholder engagement skills.

**Personal Attributes / Skills**

We are looking for someone who is:

* **Trustworthy and professional** in all dealings.
* **Reliable and dependable** , consistently delivering on commitments.
* **Customer-focused** , responsive to internal and external stakeholder needs.
* **Supportive and collaborative** , working effectively across multidisciplinary teams.
* **Self-motivated** , able to manage competing priorities and work independently.
* **Committed to quality and continuous improvement** in all aspects of work.
* **Proactive in driving safety excellence** and promoting best practice.
* **Keen to learn and develop** , keeping up to date with industry developments and regulations.

Additionally, the ideal candidate will demonstrate:

* **Excellent analytical and risk assessment skills** .
* Strong planning, organisation and attention to detail.
* **Adaptability** and flexibility in a dynamic project environment.
* Ability to influence and build strong working relationships.
* **Resilience and tenacity** , maintaining a positive approach under pressure.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.

**Essential Qualifications and Experience**

* Degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* Proven experience in a Process Safety Engineering role within power generation, energy, oil & gas, petrochemical, chemical manufacturing or a similar industrial sector.
* Experience leading or facilitating HAZOP, LOPA and other formal process safety assessments.
* Strong understanding of process safety regulations, standards and best practice.
* Full UK/EU Driving Licence.
* Eligible to work in the UK.

**Desirable Qualifications and Experience**

* Professional registration or working towards Chartered Engineer status.
* Process Safety qualification such as IChemE Process Safety, NEBOSH Process Safety Management or equivalent.
* Experience within hydrogen, renewable energy, CHP, biogas or gas-powered generation projects.
* Experience working within COMAH-regulated environments.
* Knowledge of Functional Safety and Safety Instrumented Systems (IEC 61511).

**The Benefits**

* Competitive salary.
* Generous car allowance.
* 25 days holiday, plus additional days based on service length.
* Holiday buy and sell scheme.
* Company pension contribution.
* Health care cash plan.
* Life assurance and Employee Assistance Programme.
* Hybrid working options where applicable.
* Support for professional development and certification.
* Reward and recognition schemes.

**About Clarke Energy**

Clarke Energy is a leading multinational specialist in the engineering, installation and maintenance of sustainable energy solutions. As the largest authorised distributor and service provider for INNIO's hydrogen-ready reciprocating engines, we are at the forefront of the transition to net-zero energy.

Our commitment to quality, innovation and ethical business practices drives everything we do. We offer our employees the opportunity to work on industry-leading technologies whilst developing their careers in a collaborative and supportive environment.

**Ready to Join Us?**

If you're a Process Safety Engineer passionate about creating safer, more sustainable energy solutions and want to be part of a forward-thinking engineering team, we'd love to hear from you.

**About Us**

Clarke proudly offers a rich history steeped in creativity and commitment to our associates and communities, along with competitive benefits and compensation. Our Purpose—Creating an energy resilient world for a better future—and Values: Curiosity, Trust, Pace, and Excellence, are important cultural components that shape the way we work and relate to one another. Learn more about Clarke at https://www.rehlko.com/who-we-are. In addition to the investment in your development, Clarke offers a comprehensive package with competitive salaries and a range of additional benefits.Clarke is an equal opportunity employer that prohibits discrimination and will make decisions regarding employment opportunities, including, but not limited to, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, discipline, and termination, promote equal opportunities in every aspect of our process.

**Our Values**

**Curiosity** – Seek, learn, share
  
**Trust** – Go farther together
  
**Pace** – Focus to go faster
  
**Excellence** – Find the win every day

jobs.description:
**Job Information**
-------------------

* Industry Banking
* Date Opened 10/06/2026
* Job Type Full time
* City Wrocław
* State/Province Lower Silesian Voivodeship
* Country Poland
* Zip/Postal Code 25-215

**Job Description**
-------------------

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer – AI & Automation to build greenfield applications and automation solutions that integrate **LLMs and AI capabilities** into real business and IT processes. The role focuses on hands-on software engineering using **Python, C# or Java**, developing APIs and integrations, RAG-based solutions, automated workflows, testing, monitoring, and repeatable deployments. The engineer will work directly with business stakeholders to identify automation opportunities and deliver complete, production-ready AI-enabled applications and internal mini-products rather than developing AI models themselves.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and develop applications and services using AI and LLMs
* Build business logic around existing AI models
* Integrate AI solutions with existing applications and systems
* Build APIs and system integrations
* Identify business processes which can be automated using AI
* Translate business requirements into technical requirements and acceptance criteria
* Develop automated tests
* Implement monitoring for developed solutions
* Build repeatable deployment processes
* Evaluate the quality and effectiveness of AI outputs
* Optimise performance and cost of AI solutions
* Implement security and data protection requirements
* Document technical solutions and processes

### **Requirements**

* Minimum 5 years software development experience
* Strong practical programming skills in at least one language: Python, C# or Java
* Experience designing and developing applications, services and APIs
* System integration experience
* Database experience
* Automated testing
* At least one real AI solution used by actual users
* Clear personal contribution to the code and architecture of that AI solution
* Practical experience integrating existing AI models / LLMs into applications
* Practical use of AI tools or AI agents during software development
* Ability to validate AI-generated code rather than simply accepting generated output
* Experience using AI for requirements, development, testing or documentation
* Understanding of IT security and data protection
* Ability to analyse business processes and identify automation opportunities
* Ability to work directly between business and technology

### **Benefits**

* Flexible hybrid work model (2 days/week on-site in Wrocław)
* Solid, competitive salary
* Work in a multinational environment on international projects
* Comprehensive healthcare
* Long-term B2B contract with a stable project pipeline

jobs.title: Technical Business Analyst with .NET Background
jobs.description:
Who we are
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Technical Business Analyst (Technical BA) with strong expertise in .NET applications, database analysis, and business analysis practices. The ideal candidate should be capable of understanding existing applications by analyzing source code, database structures, integrations, and business processes. The individual will work closely with business stakeholders, developers, QA teams, and project managers to translate business requirements into detailed technical user stories, functional specifications, and solution documents.
  
  
This role requires a unique combination of technical depth and business analysis skills to support application enhancements, modernization initiatives, and ongoing support activities.
  
  
What youll be doing
  
  

* Gather and analyse business requirements, translating them into clear functional and technical requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria
* Analyse existing .NET applications, APIs, services, integrations and database structures to understand system functionality and dependencies
* Review C#, .NET and SQL implementations to support reverse engineering of existing application functionality and business rules
* Analyse data flows, database schemas, stored procedures, views, SQL jobs and system dependencies
* Perform impact analysis for change requests, enhancements and defect resolution
* Facilitate requirement gathering sessions and discussions between business stakeholders, Developers, Architects, QA teams and Project Managers
* Document AS-IS and TO-BE processes, workflows, system interactions, data mappings and integration requirements
* Develop functional and technical specifications that provide clear guidance to development teams
* Collaborate with technical teams to identify solution approaches, dependencies, constraints and implementation impacts
* Support system integration analysis across applications, APIs, databases and external platforms
* Contribute to backlog refinement, sprint planning, requirement prioritization and delivery activities
* Support QA teams with requirement clarification, test scenario preparation, UAT and defect triage
* Create and maintain project documentation including user stories, process flows, technical specifications, data mappings and design decisions
* Ensure requirements remain clear, traceable and aligned throughout the delivery lifecycle

What youll bring along
  
  

* Bachelors degree in Informatics or similar field of study, or equivalent working experience
* Minimum 5+ years of experience in a Business Analyst, Technical Business Analyst or similar role
* Strong experience analyzing Microsoft .NET Framework / .NET Core applications
* Ability to read and understand C#, ASP.NET MVC / Web API and .NET Core implementations
* Strong SQL knowledge, including queries, stored procedures, database schemas, views and database dependencies
* Experience with SQL Server, data modelling, database design concepts and data interfaces
* Good understanding of REST APIs, application integrations and system data flows
* Proven experience performing technical analysis, impact analysis and application reverse engineering
* Strong experience with requirements elicitation, user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications
* Experience documenting AS-IS and TO-BE processes, technical workflows and data mappings
* Ability to facilitate discussions between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams
* Advanced knowledge of Agile / Scrum methodology
* Experience with Azure DevOps or Jira, Confluence, Visio / Draw.io and SQL Server Management Studio
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and documentation skills
* Well-structured and organised working methodology
* Excellent English verbal and written skills

-------------------------

Je werkt nauw samen met de solution designer en businessstakeholders om ideeën te vertalen naar betrouwbare en doeltreffende applicaties. Daarbij verdiep je je in de bedrijfscontext, zodat jouw oplossingen aansluiten bij de operationele behoeften.
